name: @vivswan/github-settings-as-code
description: GitHub Action applying declarative repository settings: rulesets, labels, branch protection, and more.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run lint:yaml && bun run lint:arch && bun run typecheck && bun run knip && bun run test && bun run build:check
scripts.lint:yaml: if command -v yamllint >/dev/null 2>&1; then git ls-files -z '*.yml' '*.yaml' | xargs -0 yamllint -s; else echo 'lint:yaml: yamllint not installed, skipping (CI enforces it; install with pip install yamllint or brew install yamllint)'; fi
scripts.lint:package: bun x publint --strict && bun x attw --pack . --profile esm-only
scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:lib && bun run build:schema && bun run build:docs && bun run build:action-docs
scripts.build:check: bun run build:schema && git diff --exit-code lib/settings.schema.json && ! git ls-files --others --exclude-standard lib/settings.schema.json | grep . && bun run build:docs && bun run build:action-docs && git diff --exit-code README.md COVERAGE.md action.yml docs/start/getting-started.md docs/reference/sections.md docs/reference/inputs.md docs/reference/architecture.md docs/reference/undeclared-policy.md docs/reference/permissions.md docs/operate/check-mode.md && ! git ls-files --others --exclude-standard README.md COVERAGE.md action.yml docs/start/getting-started.md docs/reference/sections.md docs/reference/inputs.md docs/reference/architecture.md docs/reference/undeclared-policy.md docs/reference/permissions.md docs/operate/check-mode.md | grep .
